## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

.agents/README.md
# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

import { startForCapture } from './capture-start.mjs'
import captures from './wip-screenshots.cjs'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import { readFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const runtime = join(process.env.HOME, '.local/share/omgithub-playwright')
const require = createRequire(join(runtime, 'package.json'))
const { chromium } = require('playwright')
captures.instrument({ chromium })
const config = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, process.platform === 'darwin' ? 'metal.json' : 'linux.json'), 'utf8'))
if (process.platform === 'linux') process.env.DISPLAY ||= ':' + readFileSync(join(runtime, 'display'), 'utf8').trim()
const url = process.env.CAPTURE_URL, output = process.env.CAPTURE_DIR
if (!url || !output) throw new Error('Set CAPTURE_URL and CAPTURE_DIR.')
mkdirSync(output, { recursive: true })
const transient = error => { throw Object.assign(error, { exitCode: 75 }) }
let browser
try {
  browser = await chromium.launch({ ...config.browser.launchOptions, timeout: 30000 }).catch(transient)
  for (const [name, width, height] of [['desktop', 1440, 900], ['mobile', 390, 844]]) {
    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height } }).catch(transient)
    page.setDefaultTimeout(30000)
    const failures = []
    page.on('pageerror', error => { console.error(error.message); failures.push(error.message) })
    page.on('response', response => { if (response.status() >= 400 && new URL(response.url()).origin === new URL(url).origin) failures.push(`HTTP ${response.status()}: ${response.url()}`) })
    const response = await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load', timeout: 45000 }).catch(transient)
    if (!response?.ok()) throw Object.assign(new Error(`HTTP ${response?.status()} loading preview`), { exitCode: !response || [408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].includes(response.status()) ? 75 : 1 })
    await page.locator(process.env.CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR || 'body').waitFor({ state: 'visible' })
    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.fonts.status === 'loaded')
    const start = await startForCapture(page, {
      enabled: process.env.CAPTURE_AUTO_START !== 'false',
      selector: process.env.CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR || ''
    })
    console.log(`Capture ${name}: auto-start ${start.clicked ? 'clicked' : start.reason}`)
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000)
    await page.screenshot({ path: join(output, `final-${name}.png`), timeout: 30000 }).catch(error => {
      if (error.name === 'TimeoutError' || !browser.isConnected()) transient(error)
      throw error
    })
    if (process.env.CAPTURE_STRICT === '1' && failures.length) throw new Error(`Published build failed: ${failures.join('; ')}`)
    await page.close()
  }
} catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode = error.exitCode || 1 }
finally { await browser?.close().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode ||= 75 }) }

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D cozy post-apocalyptic monster-raising world-builder for phone/tablet, titled “Mosslight — a cozy afterworld,” in the empty PlayGround repo.
- Verify visually via small JPEG screenshots and iterate until polished.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game, no clarifying questions; note assumptions at finish.
- Cute, cozy world builder; post-apocalyptic setting; monster raising.
- Responsive phone/tablet support with usable touch controls and safe areas.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only the latest screenshot.
- Read full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS game, no build system; default static server can serve `index.html`.
- Isometric-ish floating sanctuary diorama on Canvas 2D, with CSS overlay UI.
- Initial monsters: Mallow (moss bun), Taro (cloud pup), Juniper (petal hog). Unlock Bramble at Hearth Lv2, Nimbus at Lv3, Yuzu at Lv4.
- Initial buildings: Kettle Fire, Cloud Nest, Snack Patch, Story Stump.
- Core loop: tap pals to select and feed/play/pet; spend dew to build; tap floating resources; complete 8-quest kindness chain; Hearth warmth levels and pal XP levels.
- Local fonts downloaded (Fredoka, Fraunces), custom vector art only, generative WebAudio soundtrack/SFX, localStorage persistence.
- Initial welcome modal intentionally not shown at launch (only via Help), so screenshots show gameplay immediately.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full HTML structure and detailed responsive CSS, including HUD, quest card, hearth card, mobile chips, dock, pal care panel, build/pals/journal sheets, welcome/level-up/reset modals, placement bar and toast/burst styling.
- Created `data.js` with species, buildings, quests, hearth levels, pal levels, resources, save key.
- Created vector rendering modules:
  - `art-core.js`: helpers, iso math, shapes.
  - `art-bg.js`: sky, sun, hills, ruined skyline, floating isles, foliage, birds.
  - `art-world.js`: floating island ground, soil/roots, paths, flowers, sign.
  - `art-buildings.js`: nine illustrated buildings with animation.
  - `art-pals.js`: six animated species portraits/entities, collectibles.
- Created `audio.js`: ambient pad, chimes, interaction/level sounds, mutable.
- Created `game.js`: state/save/load, HUD, quests, care actions, build placement, production/collectibles, wandering/napping pals, sheets/modals, keyboard shortcuts, canvas input/hit testing, animation loop, boot.
- Added placement bar markup and styles.
- Downloaded font assets and created favicon reference (favicon.svg not yet created).

### Active
- Initial end-to-end browser test has not been run yet.
- Need runtime debugging, visual verification at desktop and phone sizes, gameplay interaction smoke tests, and polish.

### Blocked
- None known; first launch/test pending.

## Next Move
1. Create `assets/favicon.svg`.
2. Start static server persistently (e.g. tmux with `python3 -m http.server 3000`) and open with Playwright.
3. Capture 1440×900 and 390×844 screenshots as small JPEGs; inspect latest and fix layout/rendering/errors.
4. Test interactions: select pal, feed/play/pet, build placement, collectible pickup, quest completion, level-up modal, sheet opening/closing, sound toggle, reset, reload persistence.
5. Validate no console errors/404s, mobile layout/safe areas, and tune visual density/performance.
6. Update README briefly with game description/controls and finish with assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all UI markup and popovers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: complete responsive visual system.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: game logic, input, UI, rendering loop; primary file to debug.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js`: species/building/quest/level definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-core.js`: iso helpers and drawing primitives.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-world.js`: sanctuary island rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-buildings.js`: building illustrations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-pals.js`: monster/collectible illustrations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-bg.js`: background scenery.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/audio.js`: WebAudio engine.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/`: five local TTF font files.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still template; needs game documentation.

## Important Context
- No `package.json` exists; keeping static is intentional because default runtime serves `index.html`.
- Latest edits changed direct `state.warmth +=` calls for pet/feed/play/collect into `addWarmth(...)`, added `resetting` guard, fixed Escape ordering for level-up, lowered minimum viewport height to 320, and re-render caches after `document.fonts.ready`.
- Potential runtime issues to check first:
  - `ui.palName.firstChild.textContent` assumes a text node before the level `<span>`.
  - `openSheet()`/`closeSheets()`/panel restoration interactions may hide/show pal panel unexpectedly.
  - `pointerdown` + `audio.resume()` must initialize sound only safely after gesture.
  - `favicon.svg` currently 404s until created.
  - Canvas `ctx.roundRect` requires current Chromium (available).
  - `updateHover()` can retain stale `hoverTile` when hovering pals/collectibles during placement.
- `resetGame()` reloads after clearing save; `save()` now skips when `resetting`.
- Screenshot capture runtime auto-clicks only buttons whose trimmed label matches `start` or `play`; no such exact visible button exists, so gameplay should be shown directly.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D cozy post-apocalyptic monster-raising world-builder for phone/tablet, titled “Mosslight — a cozy afterworld,” in the empty PlayGround repo.
- Verify visually via small JPEG screenshots and iterate until polished.

## Requirements
- Complete playable game, no clarifying questions; note assumptions at finish.
- Cute, cozy world builder; post-apocalyptic setting; monster raising.
- Responsive phone/tablet support with usable touch controls and safe areas.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs, viewport ≤1280px wide; read only the latest screenshot.
- Read full-size PNG only if fine detail matters.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS game, no build system; default static server can serve `index.html`.
- Isometric floating sanctuary diorama on Canvas 2D with CSS overlay UI.
- Initial pals: Mallow (moss bun), Taro (cloud pup), Juniper (petal hog). Unlock Bramble at Hearth Lv2, Nimbus at Lv3, Yuzu at Lv4.
- Initial buildings: Kettle Fire, Cloud Nest, Snack Patch, Story Stump.
- Core loop: tap pals to select/feed/play/pet; spend dew to build; collect floating resources; complete 8-quest kindness chain; Hearth warmth levels and pal XP levels.
- Local fonts, custom vector art only, generative WebAudio soundtrack/SFX, localStorage persistence.
- Welcome modal intentionally not shown at launch (only via Help), so gameplay is immediately visible.
- Mobile HUD uses three rows: brand/actions, resources, Hearth/quest chips.
- Tablets 700–880px show full Hearth/quest cards; phones use compact chips; landscape shows compact chips instead of hidden HUD.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full responsive HTML/CSS UI, including HUD, quest/hearth cards, mobile chips, dock, pal care panel, build/pals/journal sheets, welcome/level-up/reset modals, placement bar, toasts, and bursts.
- `data.js` definitions for species, buildings, quests, hearth levels, pal levels, resources, save key.
- Canvas art modules: background/skyline/isles, floating island, nine buildings, six animated pals, collectibles, portraits.
- `audio.js` ambient pad/chimes and interaction sounds; audio mute persists.
- `game.js` state/save/load, HUD/quests/care/build/production/collectibles/wandering/level-ups/sheets/modals/keyboard/canvas input/animation loop.
- Created `assets/favicon.svg`.
- Fixed duplicate `drawCollectible` identifier by renaming local renderer to `drawCollectibleEntity`.
- Added missing `ui.palsSub` reference, fixing pals-sheet crash.
- Fixed tile hit-testing dead zones by using `tileDiamond(..., 0)`.
- Reduced pet cooldown from 0.55s to 0.3s for responsive repeat petting.
- Improved scene composition and scale: smaller pals, larger buildings, spread initial pal positions, longer initial idle, shorter wander distance.
- Reworked mobile top spacing and island scale; chips no longer overlap resources.
- Added tablet/landscape HUD behavior; verified 320×568, 390×844, 768×1024, 844×390.
- Cleaned locked pal cards so ghost `? ? ?` content no longer shows behind the lock overlay.
- Added fixed unlock spawn spots for Bramble/Nimbus/Yuzu; Bramble now spawns at `[2.7, 4.9]`.
- Added a small glowing burrow with mushrooms to the cliff face in `art-world.js` (edit just applied; not yet visually verified).
- E2E tested: pal selection by canvas tap, care actions, feeding, build placement, collectible pickup, quest progression, Hearth Lv2 unlock modal, Bramble addition, sheet rendering, sound mute persistence, reload persistence, reset flow.
- No console/page errors or HTTP 404s in tested viewports.

### Active
- Need to re-capture/verify the new cliff burrow and current desktop/mobile/tablet landscape renders.
- Need one final pass on level-up/confirm modal timing and mobile scroll discoverability.
- Need to remove the temporary `window.__mosslight` debug hook before finalizing.
- Need to update `README.md` with game description, controls, and assumptions.

### Blocked
- None known.

## Next Move
1. Re-run `node /tmp/opencode/test.mjs`, `node /tmp/opencode/mobile.mjs`, and `node /tmp/opencode/viewports.mjs`; inspect latest JPEGs, especially the new cliff burrow.
2. Verify full quest chain including the active “build” quest and “play” quest, rewards, and level-up queue behavior.
3. Consider reducing modal animation duration / ensuring modal visibility on slow frames; add mobile build-sheet swipe cue or alternative layout if needed.
4. Remove `window.__mosslight` debug exposure in `boot()`.
5. Update `README.md` with game concept, controls, persistence, and assumptions.
6. Final screenshot pass at desktop/phone/tablet and finish report with assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all UI markup and modals.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive visual system and HUD/sheet/modal styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: primary game logic/input/render loop; remove debug hook here.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/data.js`: species/building/quest/level definitions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-world.js`: floating island, decor, and newly added cliff burrow.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-pals.js`: pal/collectible/portrait rendering.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-buildings.js`: building illustrations.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-bg.js`: sky, ruins, floating isles, birds.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/art-core.js`: isometric and drawing helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/audio.js`: WebAudio soundscape.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/`: local Fredoka/Fraunces TTF files.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/favicon.svg`: newly created favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: still template; needs game documentation.
- `/tmp/opencode/`: test scripts (`test.mjs`, `mobile.mjs`, `viewports.mjs`, `e2e2.mjs`, etc.) and latest screenshots in `/tmp/opencode/shots/`.

## Important Context
- Static server is running on `http://localhost:3000/` (`python3 -m http.server 3000`, PID in `/tmp/opencode/server.pid`).
- Playwright is loaded via `createRequire('/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/package.json')`; headless Chromium with SwiftShader works.
- `capture.sh` / `start.sh` depend on `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime`; default capture uses 1440×900 and 390×844 but custom tests use 1280×800 or smaller JPEGs.
- `window.__mosslight` currently exposes `{ state, view, iso, tileAtScreen, collectibles, selectPal, save, doPet, doFeed, doPlay, get gameTime() }` for tests; remove or gate before final.
- Modals can appear blank in screenshots taken ~300ms after opening because heavy canvas rendering delays animation frames; at ~1s they render correctly.
- The new cliff-burrow code was added immediately before the roots section in `art-world.js` and has not yet been screenshot-checked.
- All files are currently untracked/uncommitted (`git status` showed new files); no commits made.
- Save key: `mosslight-hollow-v1`.
- Mobile pal care panel appears polished at 390px; journal requires vertical scrolling to reach all stats.
- Build sheet on phones remains horizontal-scroll; third card title is truncated until swiped.
